title: Nexus NarrativeApi
description: Handler-local wire DTOs for the narrative read surface (`narrative-api` destination): the `WorldState` read-model projection and the list/get envelopes of `GET /v1/daemon/narrative/worlds`. Mirrors `nexus-narrative`'s serialized `WorldState` verbatim (read-only projection, not the authoritative domain aggregate).

NarrativeWorldState.title: NarrativeWorldState
NarrativeWorldState.description: Read-model projection of one World (aggregated narrative state; never the stored row).

NarrativeWorldsListResponse.title: NarrativeWorldsListResponse
NarrativeWorldsListResponse.description: Response for `GET /v1/daemon/narrative/worlds` (empty list when no Worlds are seeded).

NarrativeWorldResponse.title: NarrativeWorldResponse
NarrativeWorldResponse.description: Response for `GET /v1/daemon/narrative/worlds/{world_id}`; 404 for an unknown World id.
